Explanation 
Fetal bone development 
Adequate calcium intake during pregnancy is essential for the developing 
fetus’s bones. 
Prevention of birth abnormalities 
Folic acid may prevent neural tube abnormalities in the fetus. 
Maternal calcium stores 
If maternal calcium stores are low during pregnancy, the fetus may draw 
calcium from maternal calcium stores, further exacerbating hypocalcemia 
in the pregnant client and increasing the risk for fractures. Additionally, 
maternal calcium levels drop during lactation. Continuing prenatal 
vitamins in the postpartum period is one way to increase maternal 
calcium intake and stores.
